node.statement: In each graph coordinate supplied by lem-stage1-unitary-graph-control, the parametrization P mapsto (P,g_V(P)) is smooth and its inverse on the graph is the real-linear projection to iH; after the already-supplied affine-linear chart-coordinate transport (notation phi_V from def-approximate-unitary-space), the parametrization and inverse remain smooth, so each chart realizes calU locally as an embedded smooth graph.
